He secured 43.6% of the votes, while former Governor Andrew Cuomo, who was seeking a comeback, received 36%. Mamdani, a Muslim of Indian descent, is a member of the New York State Assembly and has been endorsed by Senator Bernie Sanders and Representative Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez. Cuomo, on the other hand, was supported by former President Bill Clinton and former New York City Mayor Michael Bloomberg. The current mayor, Eric Adams, will run as an independent in the November election, while Curtis Sliwa, a Republican and founder of the Guardian Angels, will also be a candidate. 'It's a great day,' said Mamdani, who can now count on the nomination as the party's mayoral candidate. 'I'm proud to have the support of so many people who believe in a more just and equitable New York City.'
